_comment: Curated electronic travel authorisations & arrival cards (June 2026). leadDays = recommended days before departure to apply. window = earliest the application CAN be made (days before arrival), null = any time. Always deep-link OFFICIAL portals only.

US.name: ESTA
US.note: Apply at least 72 hours before departure.

GB.name: UK ETA
GB.note: Required for visa-free nationalities incl. EU; usually decided within 3 working days.

CA.name: Canada eTA
CA.note: Air arrivals only. Most approvals within minutes, can take days.

AU.name: Australia ETA (subclass 601)
AU.note: Apply via the AustralianETA mobile app.

NZ.name: NZeTA + IVL
NZ.note: Allow up to 72 hours for processing; includes the International Visitor Levy.

TH.name: Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC)
TH.note: Mandatory for all foreign visitors. Submit within 3 days before arrival — it cannot be filed earlier. Official site is free; ignore paid third-party sites.

SG.name: SG Arrival Card
SG.note: Submit within 3 days before arrival. Free on the official ICA site.

KR.name: K-ETA
KR.note: 22 nationalities (incl. SG, US, UK, most EU) are exempt until 31 Dec 2026, but the e-Arrival Card (within 72h) still applies.

IN.name: India e-Visa
IN.note: Apply at least 4 days before arrival; allow ~72h processing.

VN.name: Vietnam e-Visa
VN.note: ~3 working days processing. Available to all nationalities.

ID.name: Indonesia e-VOA
ID.note: Pay the separate Bali tourist levy at lovebali.baliprov.go.id if visiting Bali.

LK.name: Sri Lanka ETA
LK.note: Free ETA for 40 nationalities since May 2026.

TR.name: Türkiye e-Visa
TR.note: Issued in minutes for eligible nationalities.

KE.name: Kenya eTA
KE.note: ~3 days processing; African passport holders exempt.

SA.name: Saudi eVisa
SA.note: Usually issued within minutes to 48 hours.

IL.name: ETA-IL
IL.note: Apply at least 72 hours before departure.
